docs.title: Introduction: Biticius Farticus and the Farticus Power
docs.text:
Biticius Farticus is not just another meme token. It is a token with real and exclusive utility within the Runes Protocol ecosystem. Biticius has the unique mystical ability known as "Farticus Power" to transform methane sats into Bitcoin with the help of the Wizard of Magic Money.

This narrative has led to the creation of a highly recognizable and symbolic inscription: BITCOIN•BTC. When users search for "Bitcoin" on major platforms like CoinMarketCap or CoinGecko, the term "Bitcoin BTC" appears, creating an immediate mental link to one of the most sought-after digital assets in the world.

This yellowpaper presents the philosophical foundations, economic structure, and mechanisms that empower BITICIUS•FARTICUS and BITCOIN•BTC as unique, narrative-backed digital assets with real-world impact.

docs.title: Deflationary Model & Price Progression Lock Mechanism
docs.text:
BITCOIN•BTC (ᛒ) will be released progressively using a deflationary model that ties each batch to market activity and completion.

  • No batch is released until the previous one is completely sold.
  • Next price level is set at either:
  • 25% higher than the last batch price, or
  • 25% higher than the current market price. ➤ whichever is higher.

This ensures: - Upward price pressure. - Incentivized early participation. - A deflationary and demand-driven supply model.

docs.title: Use of Funds
docs.text:
All funds collected from BITCOIN•BTC (ᛒ) sales will be allocated strategically for:

  • BITICIUS•FARTICUS (BTF) CEX Listings: Progressively across Tier 3, Tier 2, and Tier 1 platforms.
  • Brand Visibility & Demand Growth: Enhancing recognition of BITICIUS•FARTICUS (BTF) and BITCOIN•BTC (ᛒ).

This approach supports the transition from centralized management to decentralized community governance, ensuring:

  • Sustainable development.
  • Efficient capital allocation.
  • Growth of the Biticius ecosystem.

The limited use of minting (only 10%) avoids unnecessary inflation and miner-dilution, ensuring that resources are directed where they matter most: community and infrastructure. - A deflationary and demand-driven supply model.
